title: Soft bedding, pillows, bumper pads, and toys stay out of the baby's sleep area
summary: CDC says to keep soft bedding out of the baby's sleep area, including blankets, pillows, bumper pads, and soft toys.
body: The safe-sleep page says to keep soft bedding out of the baby's sleep area. The items it names are blankets, pillows, bumper pads, and soft toys. A bare fitted sheet on a firm mattress is the surface described on the previous line of that page. NICHD's campaign FAQ goes further on bumper pads and on a US law about selling them. This card is only the CDC list of what stays out. It is a US recommendation, not a description of every family's crib.

sources.title: Providing Care for Babies to Sleep Safely
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US federal page, public domain. CDC says it supports the 2022 AAP recommendations. Page updated 17 September 2024.
